# RK Consulting Limited

> RK Consulting is an Auckland-based data, analytics and AI consultancy founded by Rahul Khatri in 2021.
> It builds Airtable operational systems, Power BI and Looker Studio reporting, Excel and Google Sheets
> automation, and AI workflow automation (Claude, GPT and Gemini APIs orchestrated through Zapier, Make and
> Google Apps Script) for organisations in New Zealand, Australia and the Pacific.

## Key facts

- Legal name: RK Consulting Limited (NZ company number 8180378, NZBN 9429049253061), founded 2021
- Founder and principal consultant: Rahul Khatri, Google Cloud Certified Generative AI Leader, 15+ years in data and analytics
- Based in Auckland, New Zealand; works with clients across New Zealand, Australia and the Pacific
- Industry experience: telco, healthcare, FMCG, dairy, events management, aviation, government infrastructure
- Engagements: fixed-price projects, time and materials, and ongoing "Virtual Data" partnerships
- Contact: info@rkconsulting.co.nz · +64 21 026 59597 · https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/contact/ (replies within 1 business day)

## Services

- [Airtable Consulting](https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/airtable/): Base and table architecture, field structures and formulas, linked records and lookups, Interface Designer apps, automations and JavaScript scripting, integrations with Outlook, Slack, Salesforce and Xero via Zapier or Make, QA and training.
- [AI Automation](https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/ai-automation/): LLM-powered business workflows: document and data extraction, review and survey analysis, intelligent email workflows, automated narrative reporting, content classification and cross-platform orchestration, built on Claude, GPT and Gemini APIs.
- [AI Consulting](https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/ai-consulting/): AI opportunity discovery, phased roadmaps, proof-of-concept builds, responsible AI guidance, team upskilling and ongoing advisory. Tool-agnostic.
- [Power BI](https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/power-bi/): Executive dashboards, financial reporting, star and snowflake schema data modelling, migration from Excel, SSRS and Tableau, row-level security and governance, Azure OpenAI and Copilot integration.
- [Looker Studio](https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/looker-studio/): Dashboard design and build; Google Sheets, BigQuery, GA4, Google Ads and Search Console integration; calculated fields; Apps Script data pipelines; marketing analytics; reusable templates.
- [Spreadsheets](https://www.rkconsulting.co.nz/spreadsheets/): Advanced Excel and Google Sheets forecasting models, dashboards, Apps Script automation, templates, system integration and AI-powered analysis inside Sheets.

## Proof of work

- [Airtable workforce and accreditation platform for a large events company](https://www.unicornfactory.nz/case-studies/event-management-platform-airtable-solution): 300+ people across multiple roles; onboarding, compliance, contracts and live accreditation built on Airtable, Airtable Forms, Cognito Forms, Zapier, PDF contract generation and email automation.
